issue.title: [reboot] Pmon doesn't work well after reboot on th2

failure.body:
#### Description

Based on latest 202012 image SONiC.20201231.36, run the test_reboot.py test cases, the pmon doesn't work well. Some of daemons is stopped.
#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run test_reboot.py test case on th2
2. It will report error "Not all pmon daemons running".

resolution.title: [202012] [Arista] Enable syseepromd update database (with 202012 fix)
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
The previous PR https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/8914 was reverted due to crashing the 202012 syseepromd.

#### How I did it
Tested the 202012 image with change and fixed the disparity between master and 202012.

#### How to verify it
Run the built image on the dut and syseepromd will not crash, and in redis-cli can fetch the eeprom information.

#### Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)

- [ ] 201811
- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202006
- [ ] 202012
- [ ] 202106
